module_summary: Sequential radix-2 restoring divider: a 16-bit shift register holds remainder/quotient, updated each cycle by a subtract-and-mux step under a bit counter, with valid/ready result handshake and sign correction.

anchors.name: SR
anchors.why: Shift register holding partial remainder (upper) and quotient (lower) during division.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Iteration counter; cnt[3] ends division and raises res_valid.

anchors.name: start_cnt
anchors.why: Busy flag set on operation start, gates the iterative SR/cnt updates.

anchors.name: opn_valid
anchors.why: Operation request; starts division and latches operands when idle.

anchors.name: res_valid
anchors.why: Result valid, set at count end, cleared on data_go acceptance.

anchors.name: res_ready
anchors.why: Downstream accepts result; with res_valid forms data_go clearing valid.

anchors.name: result
anchors.why: 16-bit output of sign-corrected remainder and quotient.

anchors.name: dividend
anchors.why: Dividend operand input, absolute value loaded into SR.

anchors.name: divisor
anchors.why: Divisor operand input, negated into NEG_DIVISOR.

anchors.name: sign
anchors.why: Selects signed vs unsigned division; steers abs and result negation.

anchors.name: NEG_DIVISOR
anchors.why: Negated divisor held across the division, added to remainder each step.

anchors.name: mux_result
anchors.why: Restoring step result: subtraction or unchanged remainder shifted into SR.

anchors.name: CO
anchors.why: Carry-out of trial subtraction; selects mux_result and becomes quotient bit.

anchors.name: sub_result
anchors.why: Trial subtraction of remainder plus NEG_DIVISOR.

anchors.name: dividend_save
anchors.why: Latched dividend, its sign bit drives result sign correction.

anchors.name: divisor_save
anchors.why: Latched divisor, its sign bit decides quotient negation.

anchors.name: remainer
anchors.why: Sign-corrected remainder forming result upper byte.

anchors.name: quotient
anchors.why: Sign-corrected quotient forming result lower byte.

anchors.name: data_go
anchors.why: Handshake completion res_valid & res_ready, clears res_valid.

groups.name: Division control
groups.description: Counter and busy flag sequencing eight iterations and result handshake.

groups.name: Shift-subtract datapath
groups.description: SR shift register with trial subtraction and restoring mux.

groups.name: Sign correction
groups.description: Saved operand signs negate remainder and quotient into result.

groups.name: Operation handshake
groups.description: Valid/ready request and result handshake with operand inputs.
